summary: Full backend + frontend testing of HR Envelope enhancements (bulk send, resend, summary, silent cancel, RBAC) and Holiday calendar legend. 16/16 backend tests pass. All required testIDs present and functional on /admin Envelopes and Holidays tabs.

issues: Non-blocking: Minified React error #418 (hydration mismatch warning) appears once on first navigation. Does not break functionality but recommend investigating root component in admin.tsx.

action_items: Optional: investigate React error #418 hydration warning on /admin first paint (cosmetic, non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routers/hr.py is 878 lines — close to guideline limit; consider splitting envelope/issuance/template handlers in a future refactor.
/app/frontend/app/admin.tsx is 4856 lines — well over the recommended 700-line limit; should be split into per-tab components for maintainability.
Backend correctly dedupes duplicate user_ids in bulk send and falls back to legacy single-object shape — good defensive behaviour.
Resend endpoint correctly rejects signed/cancelled envelopes with 400 and unknown with 404. Audit trail includes 'resent' event as required.
Cancel endpoint is confirmed silent (no email send hook). Audit contains only 'cancelled' event, no notification events.

seed_data_creation: Pytest creates 1 TEST_ staff user (test_staff_<hex>@example.com) + several TEST_HR_* envelopes (TEST_HR_SINGLE_LEGACY, TEST_HR_BULK, TEST_HR_BULK_DEDUPE, TEST_HR_TO_CANCEL, TEST_HR_CANCEL_OK). TEST_ staff user is deactivated post-run. TEST_HR_* envelopes remain attached to Paul.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_hr_envelopes.py. It auto-creates a TEST_ staff user if <2 active staff exist and stores envelope ids in pytest.<name> module attributes across classes — keep class order intact. For UI tests, the Expo Web login form submission via Enter/click is unreliable; inject JWT into localStorage under all four keys: token, access_token, auth_token, staffhub_token (the app reads any of these). React error #418 is a known noisy hydration warning, not a blocker. Backend URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Implementation passes all spec acceptance criteria across upload-and-issue (legacy + bulk + dedupe + 400/404), summary shape, resend (success + 400 cancelled + 404), silent cancel, and admin-only RBAC. Holiday legend renders with one chip per active-leave staff. HRProfileModal exposes correct hr-resend-* and hr-cancel-* testIDs per issuance.
